children: North American unit said on Thursday it has agreed to sell its interests in RISEC Holdings to Constellation Energy
for $715 million, as part of ongoing portfolio management efforts in the U.S. power market.
Seperately, the British oil and gas major will also acquire 100% equity in Hunlock Creek Generating, which owns 169 megawatts of natural gas-fired generation capacity in Pennsylvania.
